lines.text: God presides in the divine assembly and asks how long they will judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked.
God tells the assembly to defend the cause of the weak and fatherless and uphold the rights of the afflicted.
God says to rescue the weak and needy from the hand of the wicked, while the walls of Jerusalem are shaken.
God says they are gods and sons of the Most High, but like mortals they will be scattered among the nations.
The psalm calls on God to arise and judge the earth, for all the nations are His inheritance.
